=== unsupported: completion

=== unsupported: confine

=== run: another point

=== run: not in the copy
執行環境 command 只在平台的拋棄式 worktree 裡跑 mailbox-propose,這次是 mailbox-propose、在 /:指令樣板帶不了判斷點的限制,在別的地方工具會有 shell、什麼都讀得到
